summary: Learn foundational SQL for queries, joins, data checks and safe record changes. Explore the five-day course and build practical database skills.
lede: SQL training teaches analysts, reporting staff and developers to query relational databases and verify results. It covers reading schemas, filtering and joining records, aggregating results, checking for NULLs or duplicate rows, and documenting reusable queries; exercises also address authorized data changes, parameterized queries and differences between SQL implementations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who retrieve, check, change or report on relational database data as part of their daily work.
prerequisites: No prior SQL experience is assumed. You should be comfortable using a computer and working with tabular data. Query writing is required; general-purpose programming is not required.
